title: npm package.json (offline)
description: Local stand-in for https://www.schemastore.org/package.json, used when this machine cannot reach schemastore.org. Deliberately permissive - it only pins down the fields npm actually requires, so it will not report false errors on the rest of the manifest.

additionalProperties.description: A semver range, or a registry alias such as "npm:package@1.2.3".
